article.title: The real danger of AI is that it is run by evil warmongers
article.author: Caitlin A. Johnstone
article.content: The most obvious and imminent threat right now is not that artificial intelligence will outsmart us and escape our control, it’s that it is being fully controlled by humans who are stupid and evil. The post The real danger of AI is that it is run by evil warmongers appeared first on MR Online .
